title: Test suite exceeds the 3-test minimum
evidence: test.c:245-251 runs 7 test functions (json_roundtrip, health, create_and_get, validation, list_and_filter, update_and_delete, routing) with dozens of CHECK assertions
suggestion: None — coverage is thorough and hermetic (in-memory SQLite, no sockets)

title: malloc/realloc return values unchecked in request reader
evidence: api.c:31 malloc(cap) and api.c:39 realloc(buf, cap) are used without NULL checks; an allocation failure would dereference NULL
suggestion: Check allocation results and return -1 / 500 on failure

title: Unbounded request body buffering
evidence: api.c:36-70 read_request doubles the buffer until Content-Length bytes arrive with no cap, so a large/hostile Content-Length can exhaust memory
suggestion: Impose a maximum request size and reject oversized bodies with 413
